name: Welcome to Genius High
source:
■Synopsis■

A natural thinker with the ability to assess any situation, identify the optimal strategy, and execute it in the blink of an eye...

You are a true genius.

Until now, you’ve never met an equal, but all that’s about to change when you’re drafted into an elite school that caters solely to the skills of those like you…


■Characters■

Karin Mabuchi - The Perfect Genius

Even among the elite, Karin’s a cut above the rest.

An athletic hacker teeming with energy and boundless knowledge, Karin is almost too perfect for words. A natural-born leader who protects her friends, students flock to her in waves, leading you to wonder—does she have any weaknesses at all?!

Chizuru Hanamiya - The Eccentric Inventor

Chizuru’s got a way with machines. Big, small, mechanical, electronic—all her inventions are wonders of the modern world.

Despite her prodigious insight into the workings of technology, things are a little different when it comes to her relationships. Unable to hide her true feelings and emotions, her only weakness is the people around her…

Haruna Nakamiya - The Soft-spoken Artist

Haruna is an unparalleled artist whose works inspire those around her.

Although she can bring others to tears with a stroke of her paintbrush, Haruna rarely expresses any emotion herself. Her art may speak volumes, but will you ever know how she truly feels?
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210903174358/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.newromcom]Google Play[/url]]
